messages:
elaine: Quick kickoff for Cumulus co-marketing: agreed items = joint benchmark post, integration listing in Cumulus Marketplace, and a technical webinar. Tentative dates: webinar 5/10, benchmark blog 5/12, marketplace promo week 5/13-5/19.

tom: Sounds good. Primary goals: 1) drive marketplace-driven trials, 2) show realistic P95 latency and token cost, 3) capture attribution from the marketplace listing.

nisha: I'll own the landing page + marketplace excerpt. Need a short artifact from eng: baked bench numbers + methodology. Can someone drop a CSV?

ram: Eng can provide `cumulus_bench_summary.csv` and a short `README.md` for methodology. Will attach to the shared drive by Tue EOD.

elaine: Messaging guardrails: don't use absolute guarantees. Use phrasing like "observed up to 28% lower token cost in our test harness" and link to methodology. Also call out workload shape (concurrent small requests).

ben: Ops ask: leads from the Cumulus Marketplace must be routed to SFDC Campaign = "Cumulus-Integration-2026" and an external_source field = `cumulus_mp`. Then Zap to #sdr-cumulus and create a task in the queue.

tom: Tracking: set utm_source=cumulus_marketplace, utm_medium=referral, utm_campaign=cumulus-integ-0526. Also add a hidden form field `partner_id=CUM-0526`. I'll send the GTM tag.

nisha: Copy plan: two headline angles — technical audience and product audience. Will draft 4 variants and lightweight social cards. Need final numbers by Wed so I can finalize copy.

ram: Demo plan for webinar: 15m architecture + 15m benchmark walkthrough + 15m live perf demo + Q&A. For the demo I'll containerize a minimal runner: `docker run redwood/cumulus-demo:latest -p 9000:9000`.

ben: Lead handling rules: if lead.company_size > 100 and indicates POC interest, escalate to enterprise SDRs within 12 hours. Otherwise route to integrations SDR pool. Also set priority tags: marketplace=true, partner=cumulus.

elaine: Webinar logistics: host from Redwood product, partner rep opens. Need rehearsal week of 5/3. Can we secure Wednesday 5/5 10am PT?

pm-bot: Rehearsal event created -> 1770012345 (calendar invite).

ram: One legal dependency: Cumulus legal needs to approve the co-marketing brief and use of partner logos by 4/28. If that's delayed, we'll keep the webinar but delay marketplace listing.

ben: Ops implementors: add SFDC Web-to-Lead hidden fields and ensure `campaign_membership` is set. Also create a campaign member status mapping for marketplace-sourced leads.

elaine: Social strategy: lightweight technical thread + one customer story card (if partner allows). Schedule posts across Twitter/X and LinkedIn during marketplace promo week. Nisha, can you prepare 3 short posts + 1 long-form LinkedIn?

nisha: Yes. Also propose we A/B the landing page headline for first 72 hours to maximize registration conversion.

tom: For benchmark transparency: include a short reproducibility section and link to `drive.google.com/.../cumulus_bench_kit`. Avoid releasing raw logs, but provide metric CSV and config snippets.

ram: I'll scrub any sensitive config before upload and include the exact model, sequence lengths, and concurrency. We'll reference "our standard inference harness" not proprietary infra.

elaine: Action recap: Nisha (LP + social + headline variants), Ram (bench CSV + demo container), Ben (SFDC rules + Zap + routing), Tom (tracking + GTM + measurement), Elaine (partner comms + webinar host).

ben: One more routing note: add retention automation 1 if a marketplace signup consumes >15k tokens within first 10 days, create a follow-up play for growth@redwood to assess Dedicated fit.

elaine: We also need a short FAQ for the webinar. Nisha, can you draft 6-10 FAQs?

nisha: On it. I'll base on typical marketplace questions and integration concerns.

pm-bot: Reminder: legal approval deadline -> 1769980000.

tom: Please do not publish any public posts until legal signoff and live tracking in place. We'll do a dry run internally on 5/6.

elaine: Thanks all. I'll compile a GH checklist and link to this thread. Next touchpoint Fri 4/30 9am PT to confirm legal + assets. :rocket:
